header.notes: SnowPro-style French form 'Profil stratigraphique'. Org 'Banff Yoho Kootenay' / 'parcs nationaux'; Obs 'SH', Obs2 'CG', DR blank. Type de profil: Test Profile. Rugosité de surface: Smooth. Date printed '22/11/2012', Heure 12:45. Lieu 'Vermilion Study Plot'. Altitude 2140 Metres. Versant 'N/A' (aspect-degree box 0), Décliv. 0. Ép. neige 102, Eau 0, rho 0, R blank. Lat/Long blank. Enfoncement Pied 40, Skis 20. Temp. air -6.2 C, Temp. surf. -5.2 C. Neige soufflée and Marquant unchecked. Stability: Not Used. S column shows '0' on every row (not interpreted). Surface row above HS (dashed table row above the surface): +r 2-3 mm (rimed precipitation particles), no hardness/density. Notes panel: 'First pit at Vermilion Lower this season. Wx station serviced. Plot needs HIN board brought up.'

transcriber_notes: 1284x1200 render of a SnowPro-style Windows form (French labels) on a white canvas, no app branding -> source_format 'other'. Height axis has a discontinuity near 100 cm (half-drawn '100' label, 110 and 90 cm gridlines 46 px apart instead of 54, garbled 'Surface> 102' text there): heights read with the local scale on each side (2.70 px/cm; above: 150 cm at y=301; below: 0 at y=698). The F bar top at y=430 matches HS 102 on the upper scale. Boundaries 94/84/68/35/34/27/26/25/22/0 from the table leader lines in the H column (y 444/471/514/603/606/625/628/630/639) and the blue bar outlines (+-0.5 cm); 35-34, 27-26 and 26-25 are ~1 cm layers drawn as double lines. Hardness axis geometric (bars grow leftward from the right edge x=613): F/4F/1F/P/K at 13/27/54/108/216 px; bar widths 13 (F), 27 (4F), 33 (4F+), 53 (1F), 66 (1F+), 148 (P+), 108 (P); +/- confirmed by the marks under the R-column hardness symbols. '=' read as IFrc per the guide table. Test boxes point into table rows, not to the height axis, so heights are null (layers named in comments). Temperature axis 13.5 px/C, 0 C at x=586 (0 label gridline); markers at 92 and 90 cm then every 10 cm; 50-20 cm markers are partly hidden in the bar hatching (+-0.15 C); the line continues to 0 cm near -0.0..-0.3 C but markers at 10 and 0 cm cannot be separated from the hatching, so they are not recorded. No marker at the surface (printed surface temp -5.2); the dashed line above ends at the top near -6.2 (air temp, not recorded as snow temperature). theta (moisture) and HW/rho columns blank.
